Title: Ticking Generate Invoices shows Invoice Generation in Manage Contracts
Step Action: Open Manage Roles and find your own row.

Step Expected: The role is saved and you are signed in again.
The menu lists Customers, Search, Group Addresses, Exports and Invoice Generation.

Title: Unticking Generate Invoices hides Invoice Generation again
Step Action: Open Manage Roles and tick Generate Invoices for yourself.

Step Expected: The menu lists Customers, Search, Group Addresses and Exports only.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Step Action: Cleanup: make sure only Admin is ticked.

Title: Ticking one more role leaves every section menu unchanged
Step Action: Open Manage Roles and tick the role in the row for yourself.
Read the menu of each section.
Step Expected: The items match the Navigations pictures (Manage Contracts without Invoice Generation).
